title: Chapter 107 Quadruple Kill, Tiger Cade
content:
Chapter 107 Quadruple Kill, Tiger Cade

"Sister Ling'er!"

Dongfang Ling looked up and found that her best friend Xu Qing rushed over with Fang Kai and others.

"Miss, I'm late. Are you not injured?" Fang Kai apologized and showed a concerned look.

"Ling'er."

As soon as Xie Fan finished speaking, Zhang Jinsheng choked: "Did you call Ling'er too?"

He came close to Dongfang Ling and saw that she was fine. He smiled and said, "Are you okay?"

Dongfang Ling saw the arrival of several people and showed a pleasant look on her face. She said excitedly: "You came at the right time. Help to eliminate these bosses."

"Yes, Miss."

"Okay."

Xu Qing and Dongfang Ling dealt with the beetles with thick skin and flesh together, while Fang Kai chose the bull.

Xie Fan went to the injured spider.

The reason why he chose the spider boss was not because she was injured, but because he wanted to show his strong strength in front of Wang Shuo.

In short, show off.

Wang Shuo was stunned when he saw the few people who suddenly joined.

Although the other party came to help him, he did not relax his vigilance against them.

After cleaning the spider webs on his body, Wang Shuo also joined Ayub in the battle with the silver tiger.

At this moment, the balance of victory in the battle with the boss began to tilt towards Wana Village.

The ordinary beasts around were basically cleared out.

But the remaining bosses still had more than half of their health.

The arrow tower once again used up all the arrows.

The energy tower was almost reaching its limit.

There were still a few spears left on the bronze crossbow cart.

Wang Shuo also had more than 70 thunder bombs left.

The long-range weapons were almost exhausted.

The reason why there were so many thunder bombs left was mainly because there was no chance to use them.

It was not that Wang Shuo did not want to use thunder bombs, but mainly because the bosses were too smart. It was difficult for thunder bombs to exert their due power. They must not be able to dodge in order to cause damage.

Wang Shuo looked at his mental power and could use "iron chain binding" again.

The skill was activated.

The silver tiger Cade was immediately tied up by four black chains.

Wang Shuo called for fire support again.

Suddenly, another bronze spear flew out from the inner wall and pierced Cade.

At the same time, he pushed him back several meters.

Wang Shuo also seized the opportunity and immediately threw a thunder bomb.

Sure enough, Cade slapped it away with one claw.

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed.

However, Ayub's big move hit him hard.

It directly cut off one of his front legs.

"Roar!"

A tiger roared in the mountains and forests, and the sound spread all over the fields.

Cade let out a shocking howl.

Wang Shuo saw Ayub's attack, raised his eyebrows, and was overjoyed.

He wanted to use a big move, but unfortunately his mental strength was not enough.

He had to circle around Cade and look for his flaws.

Another energy attack was fired from the sky.

Cade's blood volume continued to decrease.

Just when he was about to break free from the chains, Wang Shuo found an opportunity and threw 10 thunder bombs directly at him.

"Bang..."

Instantly, a huge explosion sounded under Kaide.

His body was blown to pieces, and he was deader than dead.

[You killed the level 24 silver boss, Tiger ID: Tiger 10031 Kaide]

[Your level has been raised to level 21. ]

Wang Shuo looked at the system prompt and it didn't say that he was the first to kill the silver boss. It seems that other players have taken the lead.

Wang Shuo was not disappointed that he didn't get the full attribute reward. As long as he could win this battle, it didn't matter if there were any rewards.

Wang Shuo walked over and picked up the items he exploded.

[Piercing bullet +1, tiger bone +1, energy crystal +200, soul crystal +5]

Seeing these two special props, Wang Shuo was stunned.
